scripts.build: npm run build -w @musiczoom/shared && npm run build -w @musiczoom/server && npm run build -w @musiczoom/desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @musiczoom/shared && npm run dev -w @musiczoom/server
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @musiczoom/shared && npm run dev -w @musiczoom/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @musiczoom/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
